detail.tr_h: When a user attempts to create an account, the system shall reject the password if it does not contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one symbol.
detail.source: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol

detail.tr_h: When a token is generated, the system shall sign it with RS256 (asymmetric) algorithm.
detail.source: All tokens must be signed with RS256 (asymmetric)

detail.tr_h: When a connection is established, the system shall use TLS 1.2 or higher protocol.
When a user attempts to log in, the system shall lock the account after 5 failed login attempts within 30 minutes.
detail.source: Max failed login attempts: 5 before lock

detail.tr_h: When an account is locked, the system shall unlock it after 30 minutes.
When a session is created, the system shall store it with a TTL aligned with the refresh token TTL.
detail.source: Session store TTL: aligned with refresh token TTL

detail.tr_h: When a password is entered, the system shall check for at least one uppercase letter.
detail.source: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol

detail.tr_h: When a password is entered, the system shall check for at least one lowercase letter.
detail.source: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol

detail.tr_h: When a password is entered, the system shall check for at least one digit.
detail.source: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol

detail.tr_h: When a password is entered, the system shall check for at least one symbol.
detail.source: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol

detail.tr_h: When a token is verified, the system shall check for RS256 (asymmetric) signature.
detail.source: All tokens must be signed with RS256 (asymmetric)

detail.tr_h: When a connection is established, the system shall negotiate TLS version.
When a user attempts to log in more than 5 times with incorrect credentials, the system shall lock the account.
detail.source: Max failed login attempts: 5 before lock

detail.tr_h: When an account is locked, the system shall prevent login for 30 minutes.
When a session store TTL expires, the system shall remove the corresponding session data.
detail.source: Session store TTL: aligned with refresh token TTL

detail.tr_h: When a user attempts to log in after account lock duration has expired, the system shall allow login.
When a user logs in successfully, the system shall reset failed login attempt counter.
detail.source: Max failed login attempts: 5 before lock

detail.tr_h: When user attempts to login, the system shall authenticate the user.
When user attempts to change password, the system shall update the user's password.
When user enables MFA, the system shall configure MFA for the user.
When client requests token refresh, the system shall issue a new access token.
When user logs out, the system shall invalidate the user's session.
When rate limiter detects excessive login attempts, the system shall lock the account.
detail.source: Rate Limiter -> Lock account due to excessive login attempts

detail.tr_h: When user validates AuthRequest, the system shall verify the request.
When TokenService invalidates token pair, the system shall remove the tokens.
The system shall authenticate the user within 2 seconds.
The system shall update the user's password within 1 second.
The system shall configure MFA for the user within 1 second.
The system shall issue a new access token within 1 second.
When a user attempts to log in with an invalid password, the system shall lock their account after 3 failed login attempts.
